QuestInfo.name: Raining On My Parade
QuestInfo.1: Rain broke over Fox Point Village quite suddenly. You've been here for some time, but this is your first time seeing the rain. It looks like a normal sprinkle, so why do the foxes look so anxious? Ask Silver what's up.
QuestInfo.2: It's raining at Fox Point Village. The foxes seem very nervous and jittery so you asked Silver what's wrong.

1.0: Oh, Shade, thank goodness! What do we do? It's raining!
